headline: Sensex and Nifty surge 800 points led by IT giants TCS and Wipro; hospital stocks rally despite price caps

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavy buying in IT stocks including TCS, Wipro, and HCL Tech
Broad-based recovery across all sectoral indices as market sentiment turned positive
Bullish analyst sentiment on hospital stocks despite government price caps on cancer drugs
Significant reduction in market volatility with the India VIX falling by 5%
whatHappening: The Sensex surged over 800 points while the Nifty 50 traded above the 22,500 mark
Multibagger stock Cupid hit a fresh 52-week high following a 3% price jump
MidCap stocks like Colgate and SAIL emerged as top gainers in the afternoon session
IT giants TCS and Wipro led the market rally as sectoral indices turned green
summary: The Indian stock market experienced a robust rally on Friday, with the Sensex jumping 800 points and Nifty 50 crossing the 22,500 level. The surge was primarily driven by the IT sector, with TCS and Wipro leading the gains, alongside a strong performance from hospital stocks. Investor confidence was further bolstered by a 5% drop in the India VIX, indicating lower market volatility.
